Dennis Schröder is 6-1 (185 cm) tall.

Dennis Schröder weighs 175 lbs (79 kg).

Dennis Schröder is not in the Hall of Fame.

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

Dennis Schröder has made at least $117,271,202 playing professional basketball.
